newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ATHLETICS-MASTERKOVA SEEKING GOLD IN ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MASTERKOVA SEEKING GOLD IN ATHENS.

text.p: Double Atlanta gold medallist Svetlana Masterkova said on Thursday she hoped to win at least one gold at the world athletics championships in August.
Speaking at the Russian championships, Masterkova said she would be running in both the 800 and 1,500 metres, the events she won at the 1996 Olympics.
Team chief Vadim Zelechonok said on Wednesday he was confident Russia would do well in Athens and hoped to win four golds, three more than in the last world championships in Gothenburg.
